description: Machine-readable EXTERNAL anchors for TensorBEM, with a provenance gate. Every record must cite an external work (DOI/ISBN/URL + locator) and carry a reference that is re-derivable from the cited closed form without importing the package under test. See docs/external_anchors_bem.md.
provenance_rules: at least one identifier with a valid form (DOI pattern / ISBN check digit / absolute URL)
reference_method.independent_of_repo_package == true and its implementation is outside src/
stored reference reproduces from the cited equation to 1e-6 relative
solver error <= 5 % on every pointwise quantity (literature limits: their own tolerance)

redteam.models: report 16348: in-repo series labelled as literature
reference computed by the package under test
gate tolerance loosened beyond the ledger
